test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which inference is best supported by the passage?

options.text: All retailers will eventually go fully online.
Personalized experiences are key to future retail success.
Packaging waste has minimal impact on consumers.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2) Personalized experiences are key to future retail success.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage highlights that successful retailers will need to blend digital innovation, sustainable practices, and personalized customer experience. 
 
• This shows that personalization is essential for competitiveness and future growth in retail.
 
• Other options contradict or oversimplify the passage’s points (e.g., not all retailers will go online, third-party delivery is not “always” unprofitable).
 
• The inference aligns with the idea that retailers must differentiate through customer-focused strategies rather than rely solely on price or convenience.

Therefore, the correct answer is– **Personalized experiences are key to future retail success.**
